title: Redirect service package selection to WhatsApp for direct seller contact

requirements.text: Replace the 'Add to Cart' button on ServiceCard component with a 'Contact on WhatsApp' button that redirects users to WhatsApp with a pre-filled message including the service details (platform, service type, quantity, price)

quotes: عند اختيار باقات من خدمات التواصل الاجتماعي ينتقل المشتري الى الواتساب للتواصل مع البائع

acceptanceCriteria: Each service card displays a WhatsApp contact button instead of 'Add to Cart' button
Button text is in Arabic: 'تواصل عبر الواتساب'
Clicking the button opens WhatsApp with pre-filled message containing service details
WhatsApp number is +212779781318 (from footer contact information)
Pre-filled message includes: platform name, service type, quantity, and price in Dirhams

requirements.text: Remove or hide the shopping cart functionality from the Header component since users will contact via WhatsApp instead of using the cart
acceptanceCriteria: Shopping cart icon and badge are removed from the Header
Cart drawer/sheet is no longer accessible
Navigation remains functional with Home, Services, and Admin links

requirements.text: Remove or disable the checkout flow including CheckoutPage and OrderSuccess components since orders will be handled through WhatsApp communication
acceptanceCriteria: Checkout route is removed or redirects to services page
Order success route is removed or redirects to services page
Users cannot access checkout flow through any navigation path

requirements.text: Update the Hero component call-to-action to emphasize browsing services and contacting via WhatsApp rather than purchasing through the website
acceptanceCriteria: Hero CTA button text remains 'تصفح الخدمات' and navigates to services page
Optional: Add supporting text indicating users can contact via WhatsApp for orders

constraints: Do not modify the backend order management system as it may still be used for tracking manual WhatsApp orders
Do not modify the admin dashboard functionality for managing services and viewing orders
Maintain all existing Arabic localization and RTL layout
Use the WhatsApp contact number +212779781318 from the existing footer
nonGoals: Creating a chat interface within the application
Building automated order confirmation system through WhatsApp
